title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Deleting a folder during the first scan no longer leaves files behind
summary: Listing every state a file can be in turned up one the watcher cannot see: the files of the very first scan, which runs without going through it.

highlights.title: Switching branch just after opening a project
highlights.description: A file whose bytes had been read was added to the index moments after its folder was gone, and nothing removed it. Cmd+T then listed a file that no longer existed.

sections.heading: Fixed
bullets: Only the files caught mid parse were affected: one not yet read fails its read, one already added is found and removed.
The removal is replayed once the scan finishes rather than filtered file by file, so the indexing path is untouched.
